Hi Camila, it's Claire. I'm calling about Thursday. Mark Ridley starts on Monday as our new Global HR Director for Financial Services, and he wants to meet every HR Business Partner in the region this week. He has sixty minutes for the whole region, so each partner has one minute. One minute, no slides. Please tell him three things: which entities you look after, who you report to, and what is inside your scope this quarter. And send me two lines about that by Wednesday at noon, so I can put them in the agenda. One more thing. He is new to South America, so say the names of the three companies slowly. Thanks, Camila. We speak on Thursday.

Hello, everyone. This is Mark Ridley. I start on Monday as Global HR Director for Financial Services, and I am recording this because I cannot meet all of you in person this week. A short introduction. I am based at headquarters, in Paris. For the last four years I looked after the rental business in Europe, so the bank and the finance company are new for me. My scope now is twelve countries and three entities, and I work closely with the CFO and with the country managers. In my first month I want to understand how each entity really works. So on Thursday, tell me three things: what you are responsible for, who your stakeholders are, and one problem you deal with every week. One minute each is enough. Thank you, and see you on Thursday.
